newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish wholesale prices up 5.5 percent in Oct.
newsitem.headline: Turkish wholesale prices up 5.5 percent in Oct.

text.p: ANKARA, NOV 4 (REUTER) - Turkish wholesale prices rose 5.5 percent in October against a 5.1 percent rise in September. the State Institute of Statistics said on Monday.
It said consumer prices rose 6.5 percent in October, up from 6.1 percent a month ago.
Year-on-year wholesale inflation rise was 82.8 percent in October, up from 79.8 percent in September, it said.
Year-on-year consumer price rise was 79.6 in October, compared to 79.3 percent a month ago.
